LanguageData.Hormones.label: Hormones
LanguageData.Hormones.description: The current hormones level of the pawn. High hormones means the pawn stays calm in battle, while low hormones causes fear and panic.
LanguageData.MuscleStrain.label: muscle strain
LanguageData.MuscleStrain.description: Muscle fatigue and strain level. Higher strain means more prone to muscle injuries. Recovers fastest during sleep; leisure activities (e.g. playing billiards, cloud watching, drinking) also recover at about half speed.
LanguageData.Cortisol.label: cortisol
LanguageData.Cortisol.description: Cortisol level reflects chronic stress state. High values suppress mood, increase disputes, and raise neurasthenia risk; stronger physique provides better buffering.
